title: Boundary homeomorphism carrying a simplex horn to a cylinder bottom
statement: For $n\geq2$ and $0\leq i\leq n$, identify the realization of the standard $n$-simplex with $\Delta^n=\{(t_0,\ldots,t_n)\in\mathbb R^{n+1}:t_j\geq0,\sum_jt_j=1\}$. Let $H_i=\{t\in\Delta^n:\text{ some }t_j=0\text{ with }j\ne i\}$ be the realized $i$-th horn, let $F_i=\{t\in\Delta^n:t_i=0\}$ be the opposite face, and let $\partial\Delta^n$ and $\partial(F_i\times[0,1])$ denote the frontiers relative to their affine spans; all spaces and subsets have their Euclidean subspace topologies [def-kun-subspace-topology]. There is a homeomorphism $\psi:\partial\Delta^n\to\partial(F_i\times[0,1])$ whose restriction maps $H_i$ homeomorphically onto $F_i\times\{0\}$.
